final: WITH status_avgs AS (SELECT si.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref WHERE sc.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY si.healtheval), with_mean AS (SELECT *, AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) OVER () AS mean_status_avg FROM status_avgs) SELECT status, total_scancount, avg_gb_per_minute, avg_gb_per_minute - mean_status_avg AS gap_from_mean FROM with_mean WHERE mean_status_avg IS NOT NULL
